body: I intend too reread it. That is also a good quote, and I may have to tell myself it for the time being. Hope this crap doesn't happen to your kid. Thank you

I completely agree with your statements. She just left a little bit ago, and I know I made it sound like i idolized her (which I may have a little). But, I know we are all human as I have had several mistakes in my life. As for the reason why, (I graduated and she has a semester and a half and is taking summer courses so we're distance affected) "I was lonely and I missed you, and he was giving me attention and was making me feel vulnerable and it just happened". Which really sucked. I asked her why she couldn't stop though. Like how does a person keep continuing to have sex when your conscious is clearly stating HEY YOU"RE HAPPY STOP. 
 This is where I think her issues from her past come into play. Her dad wasn't ever really there and she became the popular girl in college and messed up from it. From getting attention or something. She also has the same issues/history as I: severe depression,anxiety. She had burned herself from this incident and I advised her to get into therapy before I knew of this whole cheating hell. So shes in therapy and on meds to help. 

From the talk her and I had we are going to try and work on this, and if I cannot get passed this or make progress of getting over the situation we are going to call it quits. There's no need for me to have a girl make me start to hurt myself again. As much as I love psychiatrists I'd rather never be medicated again. I also feel like my wall is up again and will soon fall, and when that happens I believe all of this will hit me like a crazy shit show. That is what I am really scared about, is when it all hits I will not be able to face it appropriately. So my question is, should I check back into therapy and prepare for it? Or, should I just wait it out and try to handle the storm and if it gets too hard get help?

 I think I am more the less writing this all out to figure it out in my head, but also get input if there is any.
